sections.title: Fishing
sections.note: The Fishing Rod and the six fish in the Fishing Journal.

items.name: The 'mermaid'
items.howTo: Clear the monsters around Bannan Island, hit the 'mermaid' (Joanne) with the Boomerang when she surfaces, then see the Old Wayfarer once she's moved in.

items.name: Skippyjack
items.howTo: Fish at any fish shadow on the Sea Chart; the smallest and most common catch.

items.name: Toona
items.howTo: Fish at any fish shadow; common, a little larger than a Skippyjack.

items.name: Loovar
items.howTo: Fish at any fish shadow; rarer and larger.

items.name: Big Catch Lure
items.howTo: Show the Old Wayfarer a Loovar.
items.notes: StrategyWiki says he wants one of each of the first three fish.

items.name: Rusty Swordfish
items.howTo: With the Big Catch Lure, fish at a swordfish-shaped shadow, then show it to the Old Wayfarer.
items.reward: A Ship Part, and he tells you about the Neptoona

items.name: Neptoona
items.howTo: After the Rusty Swordfish, fish at the black swordfish shadows until one is the Neptoona, and show it to the Old Wayfarer.
items.notes: It can only be caught once.

items.name: Stowfish
items.howTo: Sometimes attached to a larger fish you reel in; show it to the Old Wayfarer.

sections.title: Trading Quest
sections.note: Five trades between the Traveler's Ships, for the Great Spin Attack.

items.name: Hero's New Clothes
items.howTo: Clear the enemies on the Man of Smiles's Traveler's Ship in the Northeastern Sea; he gives them with Treasure Map #26.

items.name: Kaleidoscope
items.howTo: Give the Hero's New Clothes to Nyeve on the Prince of Red Lions.

items.name: Guard Notebook
items.howTo: Give the Kaleidoscope to the Ho Ho without a telescope (Hoiger Howgendoogen) on the Ho Ho Tribe's Traveler's Ship.

items.name: Wood Heart
items.howTo: Give the Guard Notebook to Nyave on his Traveler's Ship in the Southwestern Sea.

items.name: Swordsman's Scroll
items.howTo: Give the Wood Heart to the Old Wayfarer, adrift on his ship the S.S. Wayfarer while the mermaid eats his supplies.
items.notes: Zelda Wiki says the S.S. Wayfarer appears only once, for this trade.

sections.title: Mini-games
sections.note: The best prize of each, as tiers where there's more than one.

tiers.name: Play
tiers.howTo: Bomb open the cave by the bridge and play Salvatore's Cannon Game (20 Rupees).
tiers.reward: A Wisdom Gem by letter the next day

tiers.name: 1,700 points
tiers.howTo: Score 1,700–1,999 at Romanos's Shooting Range (20 Rupees), open after the Temple of Courage.

items.name: Nyeve's challenge
items.howTo: Hit Nyeve 100 times before he hits you three times.

tiers.name: Beginner
tiers.howTo: Strike 4 Boing Statues in 90 seconds and open the chest (20 Rupees).

tiers.name: Normal
tiers.howTo: Strike 8 in 100 seconds; they vanish from the map after 20 seconds (50 Rupees).

tiers.name: Expert
tiers.howTo: Strike 14 in 120 seconds; one needs the Grappling Hook (100 Rupees).
tiers.reward: Heart Container, then a Big Gold Rupee

items.name: Goron Game
items.howTo: After the Temple of Ice and Gongoron's letter, steer Gongoron through the island's crystals (50 Rupees) and beat the 35-second record.

items.name: Digging Game
items.howTo: Pay 50 Rupees and dig for up to ten buried prizes, avoiding Rupoors. Keep playing until all four Treasure Maps have turned up.

sections.title: Beedle & Mail
sections.note: Beedle's membership cards and the Prize Postcard on the Collection Screen.

items.name: Freebie Card
items.howTo: Reach 20 points (Silver) at Beedle's Shop Ship; he mails it.

items.name: Compliment Card
items.howTo: Reach 50 points (Gold) at Beedle's Shop Ship; he mails it.

items.name: Complimentary Card
items.howTo: Reach 100 points (Platinum) at Beedle's Shop Ship; he mails it.
items.notes: Points: 1 per 100 Rupees spent, 5 on a Point Day. The two cards' names are swapped on the Collection Screen (Zelda Wiki).

items.name: Prize Postcard
items.howTo: Clear the Man of Smiles's ship a second time; mail the card for a prize draw.
